notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- End audio streams correctly (should fix bug for some players where the game hangs and needs to be force closed on exit)
- Precompile shaders (should reduce initial stutter for new players)
- Steam deck specific settings option
- Changed empty background to black for OLED displays

notes.title: New level, new fish, first person mode + some other stuff
notes.content:
[img]https://shared.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3521300/26f651c65afc2a5f6a5be552c159ef796854b316/ss_26f651c65afc2a5f6a5be552c159ef796854b316.1920x1080.jpg?t=1748774843[/img]

[list]
[*] New level: Swamp
[*] New fish: Red Snapper, Sunfish, Anglerfish, Moray Eel, Lionfish, Salmon (ty for the suggestion u/Talosisnotagod), Salmon Fillet
[*] First person mode (s/o to the commenter who had the idea in joels stream- I couldn't find them again but I liked the idea. As a heads up- yes, it will probably make you feel sick, but good for a laugh)
[*] Music/SFX/Voice volume changed to 50% by default instead of 100%
[*] Tutorial rings moved further apart
[*] Fixed bug where you get respawned when getting beached at the top of an island
[/list]

notes.title: Some QoL & bug fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added optional spin bar at top of screen
[*] Smoother changes in speed display
[*] Fixed issue where fish were not visible from above the water surface
[*] Added "Reset Settings" button
[*] Added "Reset Progress" button for speedrunners
[*] Added some new trick names (ty u/Shikamaru_irl)
[*] More visible unlock text
[*] Time pickups no longer regenerate in regular game mode
[*] Time pickups regeneration time reduced to 60s (now only in free play mode)
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fixes & minor tweaks
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Score updates during super jumps now work properly with all visual settings
[*] Menu music plays when returning from gameplay
[*] Countdown audio no longer persists after exiting to menu
[*] Polyclad was backwards 🙈 (also new swimming animation for it)
[*] Changed skybox for tutorial level
[*] Time powerup respawn rate changed to 2 minutes
[/list]

notes.title: Free Swim, Tutorial, New fish (and some other stuff) + bug fixes
notes.content:
Features:

[list]
[*]Volume sliders for Audio, SFX, and Voice
[*]Slider for underwater audio muffling intensity
[*]Slider to set speed blur
[*]Tips now appear on the loading screen
[*]Time pickups now regenerate after 1 minute
[*]Free Swim mode added
[*]WASD and arrow Key controls added
[*]Reduced fog
[*]Restart button added
[*]"Invisible hand" force added to subtly guide the soccer/football into the goal
[*]Pool level increased in size by 1.5×
[*]Fail sounds added (thanks to Ockeroid)
[*]Random song playback per level (instead of fixed tracks)
[*]Replaced "How to Play" text with an interactive tutorial level
[*]Added Polyclad (thanks to Zess-57) and skateboard fish
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*]Fixed: Sound cutting out when going high speed on a rail
[*]Fixed: Main menu music restarting every time the menu is revisited
[*]Fixed: Out-of-bounds error in pool
[*]Fixed: “Disable flash effects” setting not working correctly
[*]Fixed: Goal fish bun not showing when the ball is in the net
[*]Fixed: Tiling artifacts in the water shader (thanks to LesusX)
[*]Fixed: Boat partially sinking
[*]Removed fish slapping sound from the “You Dried” screen
[*]Moved time pickup that was clipping into a cannon
[*]Hopefully fixed: Unable to scroll after resolution change (unable to replicate)
[*]Increased overall fish movement speed (there were some issues where the speed slowed down unnecessarily)
[/list]

Special thanks to WhiteRedBirb, Cygnus, Grímsdóttir, [WAFFL] Spookdi, Pyramid Song (Tay), Cybersnewp, hollow_art_, LesusX, Ockeroid, Zess-57 and others (there was a lot of people- sorry if I missed you) for the ideas and feedback.
